content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Drama Serials 0.3's PostDrama Serials 0.3March 29 at 6:30 AM · Shared with PublicAll About UCLA Basketball Star Lauren Betts' Parents, Andy and Michelle BettsUCLA women's basketball standout Lauren Betts, a 6'7" center, credits much of her athletic success to her parents, Andy (Andrew) Betts and Michelle Betts, both former Division I athletes at Long Beach State.Andy Betts, a 7'1" British former professional basketball player born in 1977, enjoyed a standout collegiate career at Long Beach State after starting at LIU Post. He was selected in the second round of the 1998 NBA Draft by the Charlotte Hornets but played primarily overseas for over a decade in leagues across Spain, Italy, Greece, and Ukraine. He also represented Great Britain and England nationally. Lauren was born in Vitoria-Gasteiz, Spain, during his playing days there. Now living in the U.S., Andy embraces fatherhood and has served as a sporting ambassador for his hometown club, Leicester Riders.Michelle Betts was a standout volleyball player for the Long Beach State Dirtbags, helping the team win the 1993 NCAA national championship. She later worked as an academic advisor and mentor to student-athletes.The couple, who have co-parented while supporting their children's athletic pursuits, raised four kids in a highly athletic household: Lauren and sister Sienna (both playing basketball at UCLA), brother Dylan (a tall rising basketball talent), and youngest Ashton. The family spent time in Europe early on before settling in Centennial, Colorado.Michelle and Andy have emphasized letting each child pursue what suits them individually, fostering a supportive environment without pressure.
